title: Equipment
description: View the copy of equipment data stored in Apex. Event dates use the Asia/Almaty time zone.
storeSearchHint: Server search of the accessible store registry. Results are not limited to the current equipment page.
noStores: No accessible stores on this search page. Change the search or go to the previous page.
selectedUnavailable: The selected store name is unavailable. The ID filter is retained.
storesUnavailable: Some store names are unavailable. IDs are shown instead; equipment remains in the list.
searchHint: Case-insensitive search for part of the value.
statusHint: Exact, case-sensitive raw status. Leave empty for any status.
invalid: Invalid tab, filter or page. Check the address parameters or reset the filters.

errors.denied: The server denied access to equipment. Access permissions need to be checked.
errors.missing: The equipment source is unavailable in the API. Server configuration is required.
errors.invalid: The server response does not match the expected format, selected store or page boundaries. Data has not been displayed.
errors.unavailable: Could not retrieve data. Please try again.

empty.title: No accessible records
empty.body: The Apex source returned no accessible equipment of this type.

noMatches.title: No matches
noMatches.body: Change the search or filters, or reset them.
